quest.title: "Fin of Watatsumi"
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x15000

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: "For the retainers of other lands shall come from abroad..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Stone Tablet
dialogues.text: "...The two greet each other like scale and fin, like thigh and bone, ever connected, aiding in our great Omikami's rule..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, "the two greet each other," huh... Maybe this means that we need to pair off those fish statues we saw before so they face the center of those big discs?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, now Paimon's hungry for fish...

talks.objective: Read the stone tablet at the "Fin"
